KB.Article.Stations.Title: Favorites, Custom Streams & Global Search
KB.Article.Stations.Summary: KINK channels out of the box plus 40,000+ worldwide streams via Radio Browser.
KB.Article.Stations.Body:
Dial ships with the four official KINK stations (KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's). Use the Discover tab to browse worldwide streams by name, genre, or country.

In Edit mode you can add custom URLs, rename or reorder favorites, and export/import playlists via .chassispack files or DIAL-v1 clipboard codes.
KB.Article.TimerMini.Title: Sleep Timer, Mini-Player & Hotkeys
KB.Article.TimerMini.Summary: Up to 6-hour sleep timer, compact mini-player (Ctrl+M), and Windows 11 media keys.
KB.Article.TimerMini.Body:
Schedule playback shutdown up to 6 hours ahead from the timer button. Press Ctrl+M to toggle the compact mini-player (optionally pinned Always on Top).

Hardware media keys (SMTC) work automatically; optional system-wide hotkeys can be enabled in Settings -> Radio.
KB.Article.Tray.Title: Background Playback & System Tray
KB.Article.Tray.Summary: Collapse cleanly to the system tray with low RAM footprint while audio keeps playing.
KB.Article.Tray.Body:
When closing or minimizing the window, Dial hides into the Windows 11 notification area and purges its XAML view tree via GC.Collect(1).

Right-click the tray icon to switch stations, pause or resume, mute, or cancel an active sleep timer.
KB.Article.Storage.Title: Isolated Storage & Single-Instance
KB.Article.Storage.Summary: Settings stored under %AppData%\Dial with single-instance activation redirect.
KB.Article.Storage.Body: Favorites, listening statistics, and preferences persist atomically in %AppData%\Dial\. Launching Dial a second time brings the active instance back into focus.
Changelog.v020.RebrandDial: Rebranded to Dial with customizable Radi-oh!-inspired favorites (list/grid toggle, position numbers, alignment, font scale) and inline edit mode.
Changelog.v020.AddedDiscover: Added Discover tab powered by Radio Browser API with A–Z country filter, genre/name search, and live stream preview.
Changelog.v020.AddedTimerStats: Added 6-hour sleep timer, live session counter, persistent per-station listening stats, and .chassispack / DIAL-v1 favorites sharing.
Changelog.v020.AddedMiniHotkeys: Added compact Mini-Player mode (Ctrl+M, Always on Top) and optional global hotkeys.
Changelog.v010.AddedRadio: Added all four KINK live radio stations: KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's (192 kbps MP3 with AAC fallback).
Changelog.v010.AddedTray: Added system tray lifecycle with right-click controls and live ICY/SMTC metadata.
